title: Module integration heartbeat (POST /integration/heartbeat)
description: Aggregate-data-only: counters prove server liveness; no player identity, IP, chat or telemetry (privacy-by-default).

token.description: server integration token issued in the owner dashboard

$comment: Response: { status, monitoring, verification }. First valid heartbeat flips verification to VERIFIED; ONLINE decays to UNKNOWN via the monitoring sweep (never fake OFFLINE). Powers LIVE aggregates (GET /activity/live).
